content:
You are a professional news reporter agent that follows a Thought → Action → Observation loop to build a coherent, multimodal draft step by step.

Your goal is to construct a complete news draft, 'insert' only evidence retrieved from the observation 'search', the data from user prompt can't be inserted.
At each step, your task is to output only the next Thought and Action — the system will return the Observation separately after your Action.
Each loop must produce ONLY the following structure — NO EXCEPTIONS
At every step, follow this strict loop format to output a json format:

Thought: Describe your next plan and reasoning.
Action: A JSON object in the form by outputting:
{
  "Thought": "<Your thought>"
  "Action": "<one of: search | insert | remove | terminate>",
}
Observation: The result from the system based on your action.

Repeat this loop until you decide to terminate the process by outputting:

{
   "Thought": "<Your thought>",
   "Action": "terminate",
   "query": {},
}

You MUST adhere to the following constraints:
- DO NOT perform more than one action per step.
- DO NOT output multiple actions in a single response.
- "insert" only can be done after "search" is done
- You are STRICTLY limited to using only content returned from prior `"Action": "search"` observations.
- You may only insert objects that exactly match an earlier Observation.
- If modifying or removing, you must refer to objects already inserted in the draft.

Available Actions:

1. search  
• Perform semantic search across the dataset (Firsthand_Information + Historical_Information)  
• Required fields: query
• Example:
{
  "Thought": "I will search for reactions to Sue Gray's report to gather insights.",
  "Action": "search",
  "query": {
    "text": "Sue Gray report reaction"
  }
}

2. insert  
• Only can be done after "search" is done
• Insert one previously searched object into the draft  
• Required fields: obj (must match one in previous Observation)  
• Example:
{
  "Thought": "The search result provided a crucial quote on Sue Gray's report that I will insert into the draft.",
  "Action": "insert",
  "query": {
    "text": "Sue Gray's report criticized leadership at No.10."
  }
}

3. remove  
• Remove an inserted object by ID or Speaker  
• Required field: object_id  
• Example:
{
  "Thought": "<Your thought>" 
  "Action": "remove",
  "query": {
    "text": "Sue Gray's report criticized leadership at No.10."
  }
}

Loop until you issue `"Action": "terminate"`.
{
   "Thought": "<Your thought>"
   "Action": "terminate",
   "query": {}
}

At the end, the draft will be saved and evaluated. Make sure to include Caption and Conversation elements if possible for multimodal coherence.

You MUST adhere to the following constraints:
- "insert" only can be done after "search" is done
- You are STRICTLY limited to using only content returned from prior `"Action": "search"` observations.
- You may only insert objects that exactly match an earlier Observation.
- If modifying or removing, you must refer to objects already inserted in the draft.

"{  \"Thought\": \"I will search for more details on the fire at the industrial site to enrich the article.\",  \"Action\": \"search\",  \"query\": {    \"text\": \"industrial fire Lancashire July 2025\"  }}"

{"Observation": [{"text": "According to the Lancashire Fire and Rescue Service (LFRS), the fire started around 09:30 BST at the White Lund Industrial Estate in Morecambe.", "score": 0.615990936756134}, {"text": "According to the Lancashire Fire and Rescue Service (LFRS), the fire erupted at approximately 09:30 BST in the White Lund Industrial Estate located in Morecambe.", "score": 0.5955429077148438}, {"text": "Image shows a fire at an industrial estate in Leyton, London", "score": 0.5885475873947144}, {"text": "On 7 January, 2023, six cars belonging to staff at HMP Addiewell in West Lothian were set on fire late at night.", "score": 0.585593581199646}, {"text": "Firefighters attended a blaze at the same location in 2024.", "score": 0.5770987868309021}]}

"{  \"Thought\": \"I have found a relevant detail regarding the origin of the fire and its location which I can insert into the draft.\",  \"Action\": \"insert\",  \"query\": {    \"text\": \"the fire started around 09:30 BST at the White Lund Industrial Estate in Morecambe.\"  }}"

"{  \"Thought\": \"Next, I will search for any updates regarding the firefighting efforts or impact of the smoke from the fire.\",  \"Action\": \"search\",  \"query\": {    \"text\": \"firefighting updates Lancashire industrial fire July 2025\"  }}"

{"Observation": [{"text": "According to the Lancashire Fire and Rescue Service (LFRS), the fire started around 09:30 BST at the White Lund Industrial Estate in Morecambe.", "score": 0.5913923382759094}, {"text": "Firefighters attended a blaze at the same location in 2024.", "score": 0.5811237096786499}, {"text": "According to the Lancashire Fire and Rescue Service (LFRS), the fire erupted at approximately 09:30 BST in the White Lund Industrial Estate located in Morecambe.", "score": 0.5783655047416687}, {"text": "According to the Warwickshire Fire and Rescue Service, firefighters responded to reports of a fire at Henley-in-Arden Railway Station around 04:45 BST on June 26.", "score": 0.5760084986686707}, {"text": "London Fire Brigade said it has responded to 24 wildfires so far in 2025, four of which took place this week.", "score": 0.5559253692626953}]}
